name: Alistigo Platform — Four-Tier Architecture
description: Alistigo is a platform for AI artifacts. Architecture is organised in four independently-versioned tiers. Artifacts run fully client-side inside iframes — no backend required.

nodes.name: End User
nodes.description: Human user interacting with an artifact in a browser

nodes.name: Claude / LLM Host
nodes.description: Claude.ai or any host that embeds artifacts in iframes and communicates via postMessage. Produces documents from prose and issues commands. Source: ADR 0020.

nodes.name: Artifact Developer
nodes.description: Developer building or extending an artifact using the platform libraries, playground, and dev tools

nodes.name: Dev Tools Tier
nodes.description: Tooling for artifact developers and QA. Not shipped in production artifacts. Packages: alistigo-artifact-playground (Vite+React dev harness), list-features (Gherkin specs), list-features-runner-playwright (Gherkin runner), agent-skill-tester.

interfaces.name: Playground UI
interfaces.description: Browser-based dev harness at localhost:5173 during development

nodes.name: Artifacts Tier
nodes.description: Artifact bundles shipped via npm and served via jsDelivr CDN. Each artifact is a self-contained UMD bundle that can be embedded in any iframe. Reference: @alistigo/artifact-list. Packages: artifact-list, list-domain, list-document-format, list-document-editor, list-components-react, artifact-list-skill.

interfaces.name: UMD Bundle
interfaces.description: Self-contained bundle served via jsDelivr, loaded by artifact-manager at runtime

interfaces.name: postMessage API (M5+)
interfaces.description: Two-way communication with host: alistigo:config, alistigo:event, alistigo:replay, alistigo:snapshot, alistigo:emitted

nodes.name: Artifact Core Tier
nodes.description: Shared libraries bundled into every artifact. Provides lifecycle, plugin API, AI chat bridge, logging. Packages: artifact-core, artifact-core-components-react, artifact-plugin-api, ai-chat-async-api, logger.

interfaces.name: TypeScript API
interfaces.description: startArtifact(), ArtifactErrorBoundary, plugin registration, ArtifactPlugin interface

nodes.name: Platform Infra Tier
nodes.description: CDN-loaded infrastructure shared across all artifacts. Versioned independently. Packages: artifact-manager, artifact-config-format, artifact-sentry-plugin, artifact-posthog-plugin, claude-storage-plugin, local-storage-plugin.

interfaces.name: CDN Script Injection
interfaces.description: artifact-manager resolves CDN URL and injects <script> for artifact UMD bundle

nodes.name: jsDelivr CDN
nodes.description: Content Delivery Network serving npm packages at pkg.jsdelivr.net. Artifacts and platform-infra packages are loaded from here at runtime. Versioning strategy: ADR 0011.

nodes.name: Sentry
nodes.description: Error monitoring SaaS. artifact-sentry-plugin reports runtime errors. ADR 0008.

nodes.name: PostHog
nodes.description: Product analytics SaaS. artifact-posthog-plugin captures usage events. ADR 0010.

nodes.name: npm Registry (GitHub Packages)
nodes.description: npm-compatible registry hosting @alistigo/* packages. Published via CI using OIDC. ADR 0014.

nodes.name: Browser Storage
nodes.description: localStorage (M1/M2) or window.storage (Claude artifact context, ADR 0005). Stores event log keyed by list @id. Future: IndexedDB for larger logs.

relationships.description: User interacts with an artifact embedded in a browser iframe
LLM host (Claude.ai) creates and embeds artifacts; communicates config and documents via postMessage
Developer uses the playground and CLI tools to build and test artifacts
Dev tools import and exercise artifact packages (Gherkin runner drives list-domain directly)
Artifacts import artifact-core lifecycle, artifact-plugin-api, logger — bundled into each artifact UMD
Artifacts rely on platform-infra for CDN loading, plugin resolution, and storage
artifact-manager fetches artifact UMD bundle from jsDelivr at runtime
artifact-sentry-plugin captures and ships runtime errors to Sentry
artifact-posthog-plugin sends usage events to PostHog
Artifacts persist the event log to browser storage via the storage plugin (LocalStorageEventStore or ClaudeStorageEventStore)
CI pipeline publishes @alistigo/* packages to npm registry on release
